title: Project progress
description: One file per project (e.g. <project folder>/progress.json), written by the project owner's tooling and read by agent-dashboard. Only source facts are stored: the ordered stages (the project's flow) and, inside each stage, its steps (the work items of that flow), each with its own dates and status. Everything derivable — stage status, stage start/end, step counts, current stage, completion ratio — is computed by the reader and must not be written here.

project.description: Project name as the project folder is named; the project's identity.

template.description: Name of the rule template the project was created from, if any.

stages.description: The project's flow, in order. A stage with no step has not started.

no.description: 1-based position in the flow (matches the stage folder number); unique.

steps.description: Work items of this stage (one per step note). Order is not significant.

path.description: Step note path relative to the project folder; unique. Its title is the step name.

date.description: Start date, or the day of a one-day item.

endDate.description: End date of a period item; while active, the latest day worked. Omitted for one-day items.
